items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: He used to have a little bit of Nelson.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. So we're going to Tulane. Yeah, that's right. And who else was in it? Who other trumpet players? Anybody else?

Oh, during that time, I'll tell you, he used to send over for the brass band, for the principal, for the brass band. He used to send off. He used to have a little bit of Nelson. I don't know if he used to send more. He used to send more. He used to send a class.
You have to answer the phone? No, he used to send more. There's nobody here. There's nobody here.
